- Early QM pioneers used "observer" language ambiguously
- Later authors sometimes read consciousness into it

  - Not supported by evidence
  - Often motivated by philosophy rather than experiments

- Show the actual measurement problem (it's genuinely fascinating without the consciousness angle)
- Explain why the terminology is misleading
